claims.text: The proposed mitigation framework integrates prompt engineering with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) without modifying model parameters.
MCP achieves higher F1 scores than conventional RAG on MedQuAD subsets.
MCP achieves higher ROUGE-L scores than conventional RAG on MedQuAD subsets.
MCP demonstrates lower abstention rates compared to conventional RAG.
Expert review confirmed reduced unsupported claims in model outputs using the proposed framework.

methodologies.name: Knowledge-Grounded Prompting Framework Evaluation
methodologies.description: Mixed-methods design implementing parallel RAG and MCP pipelines with shared retrieval and structured prompting strategies evaluated on medical QA datasets.

limitations.text: LLM deployment in healthcare is constrained by risks of hallucinated content and embedded bias.
